goal.name: SQL
goal.valid_for: Standard SQL with PostgreSQL as the free hands-on database (concepts also apply to MySQL/SQL Server)
goal.video_language_note: English videos for every topic (Alex The Analyst, techTFQ, Data with Baraa and others); Hindi alternatives from Rishabh Mishra and Data Prodigy (full-course sections where a topic video is not available).
career_outcomes: Write queries to answer business questions
Design normalized databases with keys and constraints
Use joins, CTEs and window functions confidently
Roles: Data Analyst, SQL Developer (junior), path into Backend & Data Engineering
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official docs, open-licence books, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted material re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated.

estimated_hours.note: Beginner to job-ready planning estimate. Video minutes are estimates until the link checker fills real durations (+15% rule applied in-app).
